item.title: Is Alabama a title contender RIGHT NOW? Don't mess with BAMA FANS! w/ Jake Crain!
item.author: Alabama Crimson Tide on AL.com
item.description:
Jake Crain from On3's Crain & Cone joins Ben Flanagan on Beat Everyone to talk about Alabama's big win over Florida State, the Tide's season so far, and if Kalen DeBoer's team is a contender to win it all this season. They also preview the South Carolina game and break down Ryan Grubb's comments about and apology to Crimson Tide fans after they booed his play-calling against FSU. And in honor of Grubb's flub, Jake plays the latest Beat Everyone game, "Boo or Bird?"
